title.rendered: So This Happened (EP 405) reviews: Peter Obi’s interview sparks debate

content.rendered:
Peter Obi’s appearance on Rufai Oseni’s BlackBox interview has generated intense reactions after he spoke on electricity, insecurity, and the 2027 elections while declining to reveal specific details of how he would implement some of his proposed solutions.

The interview has reignited conversations about whether political candidates can continue asking Nigerians to trust their vision without providing clearer roadmaps, as supporters praised his conviction while critics demanded more concrete policy explanations.
